intro.created: Your projects are encrypted: only you can read them. If you forget your password, this key lets you choose a new one without losing anything.
intro.migrated: This version of GANIS encrypts your projects: only you can read them. If you forget your password, this key lets you choose a new one without losing anything.
intro.regenerated: This key replaces the previous one. It lets you choose a new password if you forget yours, without losing anything.

panel.copyFailed: The key could not be copied. Write it down by hand.
panel.saveFailed: The file could not be saved. Copy the key or write it down by hand.
panel.warningTitle: It will never be shown again.
panel.warning: Write it on paper or keep the file away from this computer. Without your password or this key, your projects will be lost for good: nobody can recover them.
panel.oldKeyRevoked: The previous key no longer works.
panel.check: To confirm you wrote it down, type group no. {{number}}
panel.continue: I wrote down my key, continue

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your recovery key to choose a new password. Your projects will be kept.
forgot.recoveryKeyHint: 6 groups of 6 characters. Capitals, spaces and dashes are optional.
forgot.noKey: Without your recovery key, your projects cannot be recovered.

success.title: Password changed
success.description: You can now sign in with your new password. Your projects are intact, and your recovery key is still valid.

errors.keyFormat: The recovery key must contain 6 groups of 6 characters (letters and digits).

code.sentTo: A 6-digit code was sent to {{email}}. It is valid for a few minutes.
code.label: Code received by email
code.hint: Remember to check your spam folder.

signup.title: Verify your email address
signup.subtitle: This code confirms the address that will let you choose a new password if you forget yours.
signup.emailHint: Optional but recommended: a code sent to this address will let you choose a new password without losing your projects.

recover.subtitle: Enter your username and recovery email address: you will receive a code to choose a new password. Your projects are kept.
recover.passwordSubtitle: Address verified. Choose your new password.
recover.emailHint: The one given when the account was created or in Settings › Account.

errors.codeInvalid: Wrong or expired code. Check it or ask for a new one.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a few minutes before asking for a new code.
errors.noAccount: No email recovery is registered for this address.
errors.network: The recovery server is not responding. Check your Internet connection.
errors.notConfigured: Email recovery is not configured in this version of GANIS.
errors.saveFailed: The address is verified, but the server could not save the recovery. Try again.
errors.signupSetupFailed: Account created, but email recovery could not be enabled. Enable it in Settings › Account.
